name: wu2018
role: literature hydrodynamic coefficient set A (grader / hidden-world side only; never ship agent-side)
convention: diagonal Fossen coefficients about the CG, body axes, positive magnitudes; invariant under FRD<->FLU

units.damping_linear: N s/m x3, N m s/rad x3
units.damping_quadratic: N s^2/m^2 x3, N m s^2/rad^2 x3

identified_vehicle.inertia_note: 0.16 kg m^2 is quoted in third-party code only; not verified against the thesis

provenance: Wu (2018) Flinders University MSc thesis '6-DoF Modelling and Control of a Remotely Operated Vehicle'. Thesis not retrieved; numbers read verbatim in MarineGym BlueROVHeavy.yaml, UNav-Sim RovBodyParams.hpp, marinelab bluerov.py, CentraleNantesROV hydro.py (phase-1 notes R2 section 11 row 2, R4 section 6).
